surviving_claim: within the fixed eight-level byte-radix and uint64 physical pointer model, replacing variable-width JSON node payloads with a 256-bit occupancy bitmap plus 256 fixed uint64 pointer slots restores true 256-way physical fanout in one 4096-byte node page. A real 255->256 root transition required zero node splits, eight radix-node writes, a 46-page fresh append, two fsync barriers, and preserved exact pre/post process-crash images with scan-free frontier recovery.
non_claims: the fixed uint64 logical and physical pointer model is not mathematically unbounded
the process-crash experiment is not a hardware power-loss, torn-sector, drive-cache, or filesystem-journal correctness proof
user-space pread/pwrite counts are not storage-device I/O bounds
the experiment is single-writer and does not establish arbitrary multi-writer, distributed, or replicated correctness
total mapping metadata still grows with the number of materialized radix paths
the result does not establish production latency, throughput, reclamation, or filesystem allocated-block behavior
